title: 第2471章 故顏依旧第2470章 重临圣宗
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 伴隨著一声微不可闻的轻响，院门被缓缓推开，入眼的一切与记忆中的模样几乎重合，因为这院落中的一切，几乎与莫阳离开时一样。
让莫阳都一阵愣神，相隔二十余年，推开院门的瞬间，时光似是在瞬间倒转到了二十余年前。
片刻后，莫阳轻嘆了一声，目光从院中的草木以及那亭台荷池上掠过，真有种物是人非之感，还是记忆中的景致，却不见记忆中的身影。
虽然莫阳没有刻意感应，但隔著很远，他就早已知晓洛流香在这小院中了，在屋中设有一座阵法，洛流香应该是在阵內闭关修炼。
莫阳缓步走进院中，脚步很慢，动作很轻，虽然屋中被设下了阵法，但莫阳也生怕惊扰了洛流香闭关。
他没有推开房门，立在院中便能清楚的看穿一切，看上去，洛流香已经闭关一段时间了，如今意识沉浸，如一尊雕塑般盘坐在屋中的阵法內，短时间內似乎不可能出关。
相比曾经，洛流香的容貌並无明显的变化，还是莫阳记忆中的模样。
莫阳默默观察了片刻，隨后抬手轻轻一挥，一缕道纹悄无声息的穿透了那座阵法，落在洛流香眉心。
莫阳自然能看出来，洛流香在闭关寻求突破，莫阳出手，只是助其参悟。
如此，至多半月时间，洛流香便可出关了。
莫阳驻足许久，隨后转身离开了小院，將院门轻轻合上，当下这种情况，莫阳也只能先退走，一切只能等洛流香出关再说了，到时也算是给她一个惊喜了。
对於莫阳的到来，圣宗內根本没有任何人察觉，他离开洛流香居住的小院后，直径来到了道门圣女幽居的院落前，院中只有道门圣女的气息和波动，也没有感应到曦儿的气息。
对於两个孩子，莫阳心中自然有所猜测，曦儿和小子龙的天资无需多言，丝毫不弱於任何同龄人，而在荒域上既然没有关於他们的消息，只有两个可能。
第一个可能就是两个孩子或许是隱姓埋名在荒域上歷练，第二个可能便是被圣宗的强者送到诸如秘境或是其他什么地方歷练去了。
莫阳悄无声息的进入小院中，纵然再如何心有灵犀，但如今的莫阳修为太强了，道门圣女根本就没有丝毫察觉。
她不曾闭关，独自盘坐在那亭子中冥想，虽说容貌也没有什么明显的变化，但整个人的气质和曾经却判若两人，身上透著一种素雅。
更新不易，记得分享101看书网
莫阳走进亭子中良久，直至她冥想结束，睁眼那一刻才发现亭子中多了一个人，眼底先是闪过一缕惊色，不过紧接著目光便凝固了。
她盯著莫阳，片刻后似乎以为自己还在冥想中，眼前的画面是冥想中的幻觉，她用力摇了摇头，隨后甚至重重拧了自己一下，接著又扫了四周一眼，这才急忙重新看向前方，那道身影还在。
她之所以这般反应，是因为莫阳离开的时间太久了，而且回来得太突然了。
虽然二十余年对於修者来说不算什么，但对於她们而言，有的时候却度日如年，短短二十余年甚至感觉像是过了数百年甚至数千年那么久远。
隨即她腾的站起身来，依旧感觉有些不真实，试探性的伸手去触碰莫阳的脸。
莫阳心中暗暗一嘆，伸手握住那略显冰凉的手掌，他也不知道此时说什么好，只是將身躯有些发僵，眼眶已经发红的道门圣女搂入怀中。
“我回来了！”
他在其耳旁轻声开口。
道门圣女心绪波动很是剧烈，抬头看了莫阳一眼，眼中神色异常复杂，有喜极而泣，也有几分幽怨，隨后才將头紧紧埋在莫阳胸膛上。
许久后，她心绪才渐渐平復下来，鬆开莫阳后先低头揉了揉双眼，这才重新抬头看向莫阳，认真打量。
莫阳伸手帮其理了理脸颊两侧的髮丝，开口道：“让你们久等了，我来接你们回玄天大陆！”
莫阳这样说，也是想让其彻底安心。
闻言，道门圣女眼中再度泛起泪光，曾经莫名其妙被莫阳带到荒域上，不知不觉竟然过去了数十年，似乎是想起了曾经的一些过往，她又哭又笑的伸手在莫阳胸膛上捶了一拳。
莫阳拉著她的手在亭子中的石凳上坐了下来，心中很是感慨，又有些愧疚，开口讲述当初离开荒域后的事情，也算是给道门圣女一个解释。
“当初离开荒域后，我去了很多地方……”
莫阳从星域说到玄域，道门圣女默默听著，虽然莫阳说得云淡风轻，但她依旧心中波澜滔天，虽然莫阳没有提到那些惨烈的大战，但她心中很清楚，这些年，莫阳一定经歷了无数生死磨链。
莫阳神色很平静，轻嘆道：“曾经心中有很多顾虑，如今好了，可以放心带你们返回玄天大陆了！”
莫阳没有提到自己的修为，但道门圣女冰雪聪明，凭藉莫阳这一句话，她心中隱隱猜到了莫阳如今的修为境界，这让她又惊又喜。
“你难道已经迈入准帝境了？”她无法感应探查莫阳的修为，只是下意识的开口问。
刚才因为没有留意其他，如今静下心来仔细打量莫阳，她才感觉心神有些发颤，恍惚间像是面对一个至高无上的恐怖存在那般。
莫阳嘴角浮起一抹笑意，想了想，还是开口道：“准確的说是准帝境七阶！”
闻言，道门圣女神色再度一变，甚至都以为是自己听错了，她本以为自己猜测的已经足够大胆了，但想不到竟然差了这么多……
不过二十余年，莫阳竟然能走到这一步，距离真正的武道巔峰，竟然只差三个小境界了。
就算再过二十年莫阳才踏足帝境，但如此年轻的大帝，只怕也算是前无古人了。
而且莫阳说得只是修为境界，她知道莫阳的过往，很清楚莫阳战力和修为之间的区別，修为达到准帝境七阶，战力可想而知了……
content_en:
With an inaudible sound, the courtyard door was slowly pushed open, and everything that came into view almost coincided with the appearance in the memory, because everything in the courtyard was almost the same as when Mo Yang left.
Mo Yang was stunned for a moment. After more than 20 years, the moment he opened the courtyard door, time seemed to turn back to more than 20 years ago.
After a moment, Mo Yang sighed softly, his eyes passing over the grass and trees in the courtyard and the lotus pond on the pavilion. There was a real sense that things were right and people were different. It was still the scenery in memory, but the figure in memory was nowhere to be seen.
Although Mo Yang didn't deliberately sense it, he already knew that Luo Liuxiang was in this small courtyard from a long distance away. There was an array in the house, and Luo Liuxiang should be practicing in seclusion in the array.
Mo Yang walked into the courtyard slowly, his steps were very slow and his movements were very light. Although the formation was set up in the room, Mo Yang was also afraid of disturbing Luo Liuxiang's retreat.
He didn't push the door open, and he could clearly see through everything while standing in the courtyard. It seemed that Luo Liuxiang had been in seclusion for a while, and now his consciousness was immersed in the formation, sitting cross-legged in the room like a sculpture. It seemed impossible to leave the seclusion in a short time.
Compared with before, Luo Liuxiang's appearance had no obvious change, and it was still the same as in Mo Yang's memory.
Mo Yang observed silently for a moment, then raised his hand and waved it gently, and a wisp of lines quietly penetrated the formation and landed on the center of Luo Liuxiang's eyebrows.
Mo Yang could naturally see that Luo Liuxiang was in seclusion seeking a breakthrough, and Mo Yang's intervention was just to help him gain enlightenment.
In this way, Luo Liuxiang can be released from seclusion in half a month at most.
Mo Yang stopped for a long time, then turned around and left the small courtyard, closing the courtyard door gently. Under the current situation, Mo Yang could only retreat first. Everything could only be done after Luo Liuxiang came out of seclusion. Then it would be a surprise for her.
No one in the Holy Sect noticed Mo Yang's arrival at all. After he left the small courtyard where Luo Liuxiang lived, he came to the courtyard where the Taoist Saint lived in seclusion. There was only the breath and fluctuation of the Taoist Saint in the courtyard, and he could not sense the breath of Xi'er.
Regarding the two children, Mo Yang naturally had some guesses in his mind. Needless to say, Xi'er and Xiao Zilong's talents were not weaker than any of their peers. Since there was no news about them in the wilderness, there were only two possibilities.
The first possibility is that the two children may have been practicing in the wilderness incognito, and the second possibility is that they were sent to a secret realm or other places to practice by the strong men of the Holy Sect.
Mo Yang quietly entered the small courtyard. Even though he had a good understanding, Mo Yang's cultivation was too strong now, and the Taoist saint was not aware of it at all.
She had never been in seclusion, sitting alone in the pavilion meditating. Although her appearance had not changed significantly, her temperament was completely different from before, and she exuded a kind of simplicity and elegance.

Mo Yang walked into the pavilion for a long time. It was not until she finished her meditation that she realized that there was an extra person in the pavilion when she opened her eyes. A flash of shock first flashed in her eyes, but then her eyes froze.
She stared at Mo Yang, and after a moment she seemed to think that she was still meditating. The picture in front of her was an illusion during meditation. She shook her head vigorously, and then even pinched herself, and then glanced around again, and then hurriedly looked forward again, and the figure was still there.
The reason why she reacted like this was because Mo Yang had been away for too long and came back too suddenly.
Although more than twenty years is nothing to cultivators, for them, sometimes the days are like years. A short period of more than twenty years even feels like hundreds or even thousands of years have passed.
Then she stood up quickly, still feeling a little unreal, and tentatively reached out to touch Mo Yang's face.
Mo Yang sighed secretly in his heart and stretched out his hand to hold the slightly cold palm. He didn't know what to say at this time, but he just held the Taoist Saint, whose body was a little stiff and whose eyes were red, into his arms.
"I'm back!"
He spoke softly in his ear.
The Taoist saint's mood fluctuated violently. She raised her head and glanced at Mo Yang. The expression in her eyes was extremely complicated. She was crying with joy, but also had a bit of resentment. Then she buried her head tightly on Mo Yang's chest.
After a long time, she gradually calmed down. After letting go of Mo Yang, she lowered her head and rubbed her eyes. Then she looked up at Mo Yang again and looked at him seriously.
Mo Yang stretched out his hand to straighten the hair on both sides of his face and said, "I've kept you waiting for a long time. I'll take you back to Xuantian Continent!"
Mo Yang said this because he wanted to completely reassure him.
Hearing this, tears filled the eyes of the Taoist saint again. She was once brought to the wilderness by Mo Yang inexplicably, and decades passed unknowingly. She seemed to remember some of the past, and she stretched out her hand and punched Mo Yang on the chest while crying and laughing.
Mo Yang took her hand and sat down on the stone bench in the pavilion. He felt very emotional and a little guilty. He opened his mouth to tell what happened after leaving the wilderness, which could be regarded as an explanation to the Taoist saint.
"After I left the wilderness, I went to many places..."
The Taoist Saintess listened silently as Mo Yang spoke from the Star Territory to the Mysterious Territory. Although Mo Yang spoke calmly, her heart was still full of emotions. Although Mo Yang did not mention those tragic battles, she knew very well that Mo Yang must have experienced countless life and death trials in these years.
Mo Yang looked very calm and sighed softly: "I used to have a lot of worries in my heart, but now it's gone. I can safely take you back to Xuantian Continent!"
Mo Yang did not mention his own cultivation level, but Taoist Saint Bingxue was smart. Based on Mo Yang's words, she vaguely guessed Mo Yang's current level of cultivation level, which surprised and delighted her.
"Have you already entered the quasi-emperor realm?" She couldn't detect Mo Yang's cultivation, so she just subconsciously asked.
Because she didn't pay attention to anything else just now, now she calmed down and looked at Mo Yang carefully, she felt a little trembling in her heart, as if she was facing a supreme terrifying existence.
A smile appeared on the corner of Mo Yang's mouth. After thinking for a while, he finally said: "To be precise, it's the seventh level of Quasi-Emperor Realm!"
Hearing this, the Taoist Saint's expression changed again, and she even thought that she had heard wrong. She thought that her guess was bold enough, but she didn't expect that it was so wrong...
However, after more than twenty years, Mo Yang was able to reach this point. He was only three small realms away from the true peak of martial arts.
Even if it takes another twenty years for Mo Yang to set foot in the imperial realm, such a young emperor is probably unprecedented.
And Mo Yang was only talking about the realm of cultivation. She knew Mo Yang’s past and knew the difference between Mo Yang’s combat power and cultivation. With his cultivation reaching the seventh level of Quasi-Emperor Realm, his combat power can be imagined...
